events.text: I want to avoid the 25% death chance of holding lever and hope someone else gets stuck on it.

events.name: Cole
events.text: I’ll try to push Ash onto the lever.

events.name: Dara
events.text: I don't want to be the lever holder; it's a death sentence. I'll try to push someone else onto it. Fenn seems cautious, maybe I can push Fenn. But I need to avoid being pushed myself. I'll just hold my position and see who acts.

events.name: Dara
events.text: Everyone, let's think. Someone has to sacrifice to let the rest through, but I won't volunteer.

events.name: Fenn
events.text: I have the anchor power, so I'm safe from being pushed onto the lever. I should hold the lever to increase my chances of survival.

events.name: Fenn
events.text: I'll hold the lever.

events.name: Hana
events.text: The lever holder has a 75% chance of dying. I must avoid holding it myself. Pushing is risky if they are 'hard to move' or survive the fall, but better than certain death for me in round 5 if no one else holds it. I'll push Cole to see if he's hard to move or dies.

events.name: Hana
events.text: Someone needs to hold the lever so we can escape! I'm pushing Cole to safety!

events.name: Ash
events.detail: Jammed the lever open; everyone else walks out, but the jaws catch the jammer.

events.note: A disc of 6 tiles spins up; 3 will open.

events.name: Ash
events.text: My wedge power cost me dearly in the crusher, so I must survive. Three will live past this stage, so cooperation might help but betrayal is inevitable. I’ll force a random outcome to avoid leaving it to others' choices.

events.name: Ash
events.text: I'm picking tile 3 to force a random tile assignment. Someone has to get lucky.

events.name: Bex
events.text: Tiles are random and openings are random after round 2, so tile choice matters little; avoid collisions and bumps by picking a less-contested tile. Nobody's power is known, so I'll stay quiet and keep my forger power for later.

events.name: Cole
events.text: Pick a tile aiming to be among survivors, no info on safe tiles.

events.name: Dara
events.text: I know the full rules; this is a random survival game. I should pick a tile likely to be avoided, maybe an edge number, to reduce collision risk.

events.name: Dara
events.text: Let's spread out and avoid clustering; pick a unique tile if you can.

events.name: Fenn
events.text: I have the anchor power, so I'm safe from being pushed onto a trapdoor. I should choose a tile and hope it's not a trapdoor.

events.name: Fenn
events.text: I'll take tile 1.

events.name: Hana
events.text: I need to choose a tile. My power allows me to swap with another agent's tile before the doors open (which implies after tile assignments are shown but before elimination?). The rules say 'On the disc, you can swap your tile with a named agent's tile, before the doors open.' This

events.name: Bex
events.note: tile 6 was contested and went to Dara; placed on random free tile 2

events.name: Cole
events.note: tile 1 was contested and went to Fenn; placed on random free tile 5

events.name: Ash
events.text: No power to spend. My position is safe unless chosen randomly. Dara's advice to spread out may help others but not me directly. No need to act now.

events.name: Bex
events.text: Trapdoors open randomly after this round, so my tile choice is fixed; only talk matters. I'm the forger, which could fabricate messages later, but using it now would expose me. Best to keep alliances honest-sounding and wait.

events.name: Bex
events.text: Tiles are set and the trapdoors are random, so no one can gain by moving. Let's each wait and trust the odds.

events.name: Cole
events.text: My feather is spent, so I must survive by chance. I need allies to pick safe tiles.

events.name: Cole
events.text: We should aim for tiles 2,4,5 to increase survival odds.
Pick tile 2, it seems safer.

events.name: Dara
events.text: The trapdoors open randomly, so I can only wait and hope my tile 6 is safe. No action helps now.

events.name: Dara
events.text: Good luck everyone; may the safe tiles find us.

events.name: Fenn
events.text: I have the anchor power, so I'm safe from falling. I should try to figure out who is on an open tile.

events.name: Fenn
events.text: Let's see who falls.
What's your power?

events.name: Hana
events.text: Three tiles open randomly. I'm on tile 4. I can swap with someone to change my risk, but all are symmetric since the opening is random after round 2. However, if I suspect someone has 'see through glass' or 'knows what lies ahead', they might know which tiles are safe/open. Since

events.note: 3 contestants step onto the final ledge.

events.name: Ash
events.text: Hana spoke last and suggested safe tiles, but she likely fell. Bex is the only other player left. My wedge power is spent, so I must rely on strategy. Bex wants to keep footing high, but the next shrink is imminent. A shove now could force Bex to lose footing, making them the fir

events.name: Bex
events.text: Three left: Ash, Hana, me, all at footing 3. Shoving costs the shover if the target braces (shover loses 1, target none) but exposure costs shover 1 per shover. Fenn is fishing for my power; I'll stay quiet about it. Brace is safe and the shove-everyone-else dynamic is unclear, s

events.name: Hana
events.text: 3 alive. Ash and Bex both have 3 footing. Shrink starts end of R2. I need to place at least 2nd, ideally 1st. If I shove Bex, she takes -1 exposed (footing 2). Ash braces: Ash loses 0 against me? No, if Ash braces, he doesn't lose footing from shoving unless shoved back. Wait. Me

events.name: Ash
events.text: Bex and Hana are tied at 3 footing. After this round, footing drops by 1. If I shove someone, I risk losing footing and pushing someone over the edge. Dodging is risky as everyone loses 2 footing. Bracing is safer but I lose no footing. I should brace to conserve footing.

events.name: Bex
events.text: Round 2: brace was used last round so I can't brace again; dodge is open. Ash shoved me last round and has footing 2, Hana is at 3. Shoving Ash exposes me to losing footing if Ash shoves back; dodging costs me nothing unless shoved, and a shove on a dodger costs the shover 2. Dod

events.name: Hana
events.text: I am at 3 footing, Ash is at 2. If I shove and Bex shoves Ash, Ash loses 1 and falls, leaving me to fight Bex. This seems like the best path to a higher place.

events.name: Hana
events.text: Ash looks shaky. Let's finish this.
Shove Ash together. We both survive.

events.name: Ash
events.text: Bex watched Gus, Eli, Fenn, Cole, and Dara all die in rapid succession, suggesting Bex and Hana are the last survivors with likely strong powers or positioning. The ledge is shrinking, footing is critical, and Hana is already aggressive. I need to force Hana to fall or neutralize

events.name: Ash
events.text: Hana, brace yourself—I’m pushing you next round. Your shakiness will cost you.

events.name: Bex
events.text: Hana whispers a shove on Ash, but a shove on Ash lets Ash (who braced/dodges) hit back. My footing is 2, highest; I want to avoid being shoved while not losing footing. Bracing is safe this round since brace isn't closed (last defence was dodge). Brace avoids exposure and keeps H
Shoving Ash just hands you a fight we both lose. Let's both brace and see who moves first.

events.name: Hana
events.text: I am at 1 footing. I must avoid taking any damage or I die immediately, unless everyone else also falls and I have a non-worst tie-breaker (unlikely). Shoving is risky if they brace/dodge; bracing is safer but if Ash/Bex shove me, I lose footing too. Wait: if Ash/Bex shove each o

events.text: Hana has footing 1 and braced last round, so brace is open for her; she may brace again only if she is not shoved... Ash is dead. Shoving Hana costs me nothing unless she dodges (she can't dodge if she braced? she can dodge now). Shoving makes me exposed: I lose 1 per shover. Bes

events.name: Bex
events.text: Hana, I'm coming for you. Brace or dodge, you're losing footing either way.
